snippet.title: SOUNDGRASS - Official Gameplay Trailer | Day of the Devs Trailer
snippet.description:
SOUNDGRASS was featured at Day of the Devs: The Game Awards Edition 2025, introducing a new way of thinking about sound in games. It is a sci-fi puzzle exploration game where music and audio become your core gameplay mechanics.

You find yourself on a planet where plants emit sound, and an alien civilization is harvesting those sounds. You can interact and control plant species using your Sphere of Sound and your Sphere of Light. Each different species brings you a different sound mechanic. 

SOUNDGRASS builds a story about life, death, duality, eternity and consciousness, all from a musical perspective. Explore a planet filled with puzzles and hidden secrets, transverse biomes with different types of jumps and jetpack modes, manage your suit’s resources to survive, and slowly uncover the mystery behind this world as you talk to your personal AI.

Sound is not the background here. Sound is the game.
